info.title: Locus API
info.description: Property-context APIs for agents. Buyers need no Locus or CDP account API key. Run a free coverage preflight, then pay per call for official-record reports, local-change briefs, policy and ordinance context, and environmental records. Every paid result includes source provenance, caveats, and verify-next steps. Install the Locus agent skill with `npx @velinussage/locus-agent-skill add`.

x-locus-access.note: Paid routes use x402 or advertised MPP payment credentials. Configured x402 routes offer USDC on Base and Solana; the live 402 accepts array is authoritative. OpenAPI payment metadata does not represent a separate API-key requirement.

free.note: The free /tools/call endpoint requires a WRAPPED body: {"name": "<tool>", "arguments": { ... }}. Tool inputs go inside `arguments`, NOT at the top level. Paid /api/<slug> routes are the opposite (flat body).

paid.note: Paid Locus tools take a FLAT JSON body (fields at the top level, e.g. {"address": "..."}). Do NOT wrap the body in {name, arguments} - that wrapper is ONLY for the free POST /tools/call endpoint.

info.x-guidance: TWO CALLING CONVENTIONS (do not mix them): free tools are called at POST /tools/call with a WRAPPED body {"name": "<tool>", "arguments": {...}} (inputs inside `arguments`); paid tools are called at POST /api/<slug> with a FLAT body (inputs at the top level). Sending a flat body to /tools/call, or a wrapped body to a paid route, is the most common 400. Start with the current bundle-first agent choices at https://api.locus.report/.well-known/locus-agent-endpoints.json. The unified free+paid catalog is https://api.locus.report/.well-known/locus-tools.json; the full paid index remains https://api.locus.report/.well-known/ai-tool/index.json. Free catalog scaling knobs: https://api.locus.report/tools/list?compact=1 omits input schemas for small-context discovery, and https://api.locus.report/tools/list?category=environmental filters by category. No buyer account API key is required. Workflow: (1) Call free POST /tools/call with locus_coverage_check (or locus_lane_availability) for the address — the coverage check now SPLITS status by family (civicLaneStatus / parcelStatus / nationalEndpointStatus) and returns an `alwaysAvailable` list of national tools that fire for ANY US address, so a weak civic lane never means 'skip Locus'. New: locus_suggest_workflow (place+intent) returns a ranked endpoint plan. (2) Highest-value paid call: locus-local-policy-brief ($0.07, place+intent) — cited state bills + local ordinances affecting a place, the hardest analysis to self-compile from the free lanes (national LegiScan coverage). Confirm relevant-bill density first for free with locus_local_legislation; the paid brief returns a free diagnostic if nothing relevant is found. (3) Other atomic SKUs: locus-local-trend-brief ($0.05, place+intent) for local-change analysis; locus-place-report ($0.05, address or zip) for the full cited public-record artifact — responses can be large and may expose X-Locus-Report-* headers plus GET /api/reports?settlementTx=. Preserve X-Locus-Report-Id, X-Locus-Report-Url, X-Locus-Report-Artifact-Url, and the settlement proof so the artifact can be retrieved if a client truncates or drops the response body. Supported requests are generated synchronously and can take tens of seconds. (4) Use locus-before-you-sign ($0.07, address+intent) only when one settle is worth the convenience bundle. (5) Use locus-environmental-context ($0.05, address, latitude+longitude, or state+county; heavier call: allow 60-90s) for EPA environmental public-record context and address-level TRI/RCRA proximity, not as a substitute for free locus_environmental_history preflight. Do not use Locus for tenant screening, lending, insurance, employment, appraisal, policing, or safe/unsafe labels.
